crossRefs.note: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was…
These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were…
Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed…
This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
